title: Patient Financial Services Fee Bulletin: Charging a Patient's Own Copy under Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
Bulletin on what Riverbend Regional Health charges when a patient obtains the patient's own records through a Medical Records Request (Release of Information), with the charges worked through on hypothetical requests.

## The charging rule

A patient's own copy is charged only the fee basis of its request type. An electronic copy of records held electronically costs the flat electronic fee, all-inclusive. A paper copy costs the paper cost per page for each page produced, the pages being counted as pages produced, plus actual postage when mailed; the paper fee is the number of pages produced multiplied by the paper cost per page, rounded to the cent. Imaging on CD or DVD adds the patient media fee. A patient-directed transmission to a third party is charged as an electronic copy when sent electronically and as a paper copy otherwise, patient-directed transmissions being made electronically when the records are held electronically. Amendment requests carry no fee. No retrieval, search or certification fee is ever charged on a patient's own access request, and no rush processing is offered. Each fee component is assessed once per request.

The figures named here — the flat electronic fee, the paper cost per page, the patient media fee — and each request type's fee basis are those of the product's patient copy fee schedule.

## Charges by kind of copy

| Kind of copy | What is charged |
|---|---|
| Electronic copy of records held electronically | the flat electronic fee, all-inclusive |
| Paper copy, collected | the paper fee on the pages produced |
| Paper copy, mailed | the paper fee on the pages produced, plus actual postage |
| Imaging on CD or DVD | the patient media fee, added to the copy's charge |
| Patient-directed transmission sent electronically | as an electronic copy |
| Patient-directed transmission not sent electronically | as a paper copy |
| Amendment request | no fee |
| Retrieval, search or certification on a patient's own access request | never charged |
| Rush processing | not offered |

## Worked figures (hypothetical requests)

The schedule's figures used below are the flat electronic fee of $6.50, the paper cost per page of $0.12 and the patient media fee of $3.00; the page counts and postage are hypothetical.

1. **Electronic copy by portal download.** The charge is the flat electronic fee, $6.50, and nothing else.
2. **Electronic copy with imaging on CD.** The flat electronic fee of $6.50 together with the patient media fee of $3.00 makes $9.50.
3. **Paper copy of 143 pages produced, mailed.** 143 pages multiplied by $0.12 is $17.16, the paper fee; the actual postage of the mailing is added to it.
4. **Paper copy of 143 pages produced, collected at the HIM office.** The paper fee of $17.16; no postage, since the copy is not mailed.
5. **Patient-directed transmission of electronically held records sent by encrypted email.** Charged as an electronic copy: $6.50.

## One assessment per fee component

Each fee component is assessed once per request. Whether a component has already been assessed is read from the fee assessments recorded on that same request: a component already assessed on the request is not assessed on it a second time, while the same component on a different request of the same patient is that other request's own assessment.

The request is fulfilled when the copy is delivered.
